name: LeaguesItems
description: Adds items from the Leagues game modes to the main game - Clue compass, Fairy mushroom, Forager's pouch, Map of alacrity, Crystal of Echoes, Leprechaun's vault, Banker's briefcase, Evil eye, Arcane grimoire, Flask of fervour, Butler's bell, Minion whistle, Sage's axe, Searing boots, and Knapsack.
